name: performance

findings.message: All comment pages for the issue are fetched without a server-side time filter; for issues with long comment histories the number of API round-trips and the volume of data written to disk grow linearly with the total comment count.
findings.trigger: Every gh-backend claim attempt calls `_ccgl_race_note_first_v`; the `--paginate` flag causes rsc_gh to fetch every page of issue comments, then jq discards everything older than `since` client-side. An issue with 150 comments forces 5+ round-trips; `since` is computed but never passed to the API.
findings.accepted_if: only comments potentially within the race-detection window are fetched from GitHub — comments older than the window are excluded at the server before pagination begins.

reason: the performance lens found a medium or high or critical problem the change introduced
